image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a poppy seed bagel resting on a colorful, patterned plate (orange and yellow geometric shapes). The bagel is ring-shaped with a visible central hole, covered densely in poppy seeds. The crust appears golden-brown to dark amber with some darker, possibly toasted or slightly burnt areas. The lighting creates strong highlights and shadows, emphasizing the texture of the seeds and the crust.
